_comment: Everything you can change without touching code. Edit this file, then re-run. See docs/README.md, step 8.

cycle._comment: The cycle an application belongs to when it does not carry one.

_always_required: Required in every category, whatever the category lists.
_amount_ceiling: Above this, the application is routed for review instead of accepted. 0 disables the check.
_duplicate_scope: 'cycle' = same email twice in one cycle is a duplicate. 'ever' = same email ever.
